subject: B2 production challenge route, scanned scenery and configurable shoreline colours

notes: Camp, path and bank checkpoint bytes are identical. The delivered boss observation point moves 4 game units off the spawn so the player does not overlap the boss; it has no paired baseline.
All four challenge types use the production scenery and terrain. Population, stats and gameplay RNG remain unchanged. Existing actor art is not a C-stage delivery.
Each retained capture is one short run per version. Intermediate integration captures are not comparison rounds. GPU browser workloads did not overlap during captures.

CPU is map main-thread work, excluding authority Worker CPU and loading spikes. Live movement is wall-clock input, not fixed-tick replay. Video jumps between checkpoints before a short live movement window.
GPU bytes are resource-ledger estimates, not measured driver VRAM. The same pinned scenery allocation remains loaded while hidden in wilds.
This establishes the route and first scenery assets, not final natural shoreline geometry, foliage motion, atmosphere or a complete 60 FPS certification.
